name: cli-mode
description: Persistent CLI-agent routing through ACPX with queued forwarding and public activity: Antigravity, Claude Code, Grok Build, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Codex CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Use six persistent CLI agents through ACPX with Direct or queued Passthrough routing.
interface.longDescription: CLI-MODE routes to one persistent CLI agent with Direct mode by default or queued Passthrough forwarding. Select an agent with /cli or /cli <agent>. Each backend provides setup, public tool and message progress, and the quota reporting its runtime supports.
